## Is climate change making the biosphere greener?
<hr>

<div style="float: right; width: 65%;">

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:25px; WIDTH:350px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/greener.jpg">

* **During the last ice ages, vegetation was limited by cold and ice coverage. Warmer interglacial periods allowed forests and grasslands to expand**

<br/>

* **Pre-Industrial Era: Plant growth was controlled by natural cycles of temperature, rainfall, and nutrient availability. Human influence was largely local.**

<br/>

* **Since the 1980s, satellite imagery has shown a significant “greening” of Earth, with more leaf area and vegetation productivity in many regions.**
    + Svalbard, in the high-arctic, 30% &#8593; greenness, concurrent with &#8593; in summer temperature from 2.9 to 4.7C
    
<br/>

* **Will the CO~2~ fertilization effect continue into the future?**

</div>

## Leaf area index: What it means to be greener
<hr>
**Leaf Area Index (LAI) = the amount of leaf area present relative to the horizontal ground area**
<br/>

**Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) is a satellite-derived measurement that assesses the "greenness" and density of vegetation by measuring the difference between reflectance**

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:275px; LEFT:50px; WIDTH:600px; HEIGHT:300px" SRC="images/lai2.jpg">

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:240px; LEFT:710px; WIDTH:250px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/lai.jpg">

## Why are plants producing more leaf area?
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>
<br/>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:220px; LEFT:5px; WIDTH:450px; HEIGHT:375px" SRC="images/co2mauna.png">

<div style="float: right; width: 60%;">

* **Humans dump ~40 billion tons of CO~2~ into atmosphere**
    + EACH YEAR

<br/>

* **Atmospheric CO~2~ is a greenhouse gas**
    + &#8593; CO~2~ = &#8593; trapped heat = &#8593; surface temperatures
    
<br/> 

* **Plants fix CO~2~ from the atmosphere via Rubisco**

</div>

## Greenhouse gases make the earth warm
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:200px; WIDTH:700px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/forcing.png">

## A carbon *imbalance* exists between surfaces and air
<hr>
**Human activities have created more carbon sources than natural carbon sinks can absorb**

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:200px; LEFT:200px; WIDTH:700px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/sourcesink.png">

## The role of vegetation change
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:190px; LEFT:10px; WIDTH:530px; HEIGHT:450px" SRC="images/seesaw.png">

<div style="float: right; width: 53%;">

* **Ability to immediately fix carbon from atmosphere**
    + photosynthesis vs respiration
    + keeping pace with human emissions?
    
<br/>

* **Sequestrating carbon in wood**
    + prevents fast cycling of carbon

<br/> 

* **Transpiration adds H~2~O into atmosphere**
    + power greenhouse gas
    
</div>

## Plant carbon uptake is multi-layered
<hr>

**Growing seasons have become longer over time, primarily due to climate change causing earlier springs and later autumns (~2 additionally week in the US since early 1900's)**

## Global plant C sink: Climate warming
<hr>
<br/>
<br/>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:200px; LEFT:550px; WIDTH:550px; HEIGHT:400px" SRC="images/tempresponse.png">

* **Plants like higher temperatures to a degree**
    + faster rate of photosynthesis (limited)
    + most plants not operating at T~opt~

<br/>

* **Rubisco cheats more at high temperatures**

<br/>

* **Dependent on stomatal behavior**

<br/>
<br/>
<br/>

* **Warming may also mean &#8595; precipitation, ↑ droughts, ↑ wildfires, ↑ heatwaves**

<hr>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 65%;">

* **Phenotypic plasticity: allows individuals to respond to change within their lifetime**
    + acclimation (lifetime) vs adaptation (generations)

<br/>

* **Can plants change physiology to match new conditions?**
    + can optimums be adjusted? 

<br/>

* **Why might northern species struggle in warmer temperatures?**

* **Why might plants struggle in new precipitation regimes?**

## Climate changes are just part of global change
<hr>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 55%;">

* **Lots of other stresses on plant communities**
    + impact sustainability of greening earth
    
<br/>

* **Habit degradation from human activities**

<br/>

* **Total habitat loss**
    + agricultural conversion
    + urban growth

<br/>

* **Higher rates of exotic species invasions**

</div>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:210px; LEFT:550px; WIDTH:500px; HEIGHT:400px" SRC="images/fire.jpg">

## Is the earth still getting greener?
<hr>
<br/>

* **Greening since 1980's reduced warming ~0.2C**

<br/>

* **New science suggests browning trend**
    + greening trend stalling or reversing

<br/>

* **Related to less moisture in the air**
    + higher VPD from climate warming

<br/>

* **Why would drier air impact plant growth negatively?**

<br/>

* **Plant carbon sink alone CAN not fix global carbon imbalance**
